posts.text:
During the primary, Harris was asked "why are you a better choice than Joe Biden" and she paused and said: "I love America"

I think she'd have been a perfectly competent president, and she could give a good speech, but off the cuff, she was terrible.
posts.summary: Harris competent but weak off-the-cuff communicator during campaign
